body: A cloudy bottle and sample jar share a waxy green film. A scrap of twine around both still holds treated pasture grass.
title: cloudy water beside a sample jar

body: The ranger brought the fawn to the road and asked for a wildlife pickup. The checkpoint worker recorded one animal and no people, though the child holding its blanket stood beside him. She was still there when they shut the lane.
title: The fawn tally
